protocol: I=[21/50,11/25], terminal right rail, sharp (0,R), no masks
odds: Odd clocks and D=0 mod 3 are controls; theorem uses n=2D, D=4 mod 12.
normalization: Per original launch. Each group numerator is divided by 2^clock.
exact_cells: x, signed upper and lower line numerators over sqrt(2^clock), fair combined word count over 2^clock. All reachable band cells retained.
